causal_review: Existing App collects eligible items, selects first item according to reward_mode, creates/registers item offer, handles null, copies/new offer, sets offer_id and clears existing candidates at exactly the original location. Pure composition replaces only the following assign/append block; no changes to reward source registration, epochs, claim transactions or UI order.

complete_choices creates a temporary typed array but retains ItemDefinition references; final assign mutates the original RewardOffer.candidates array rather than replacing it. selected/eligible/resource declarations are not modified or cloned into replacement items.

Original resource order, two-candidate cap, full-health heart skip, items[1] precedence, one note fallback, duplicate stable IDs and unknown-tier GOLD/four behavior are retained. Variant cache_id/tier preserves the original string/StringName comparison and concatenation behavior; existing casts for resource amount/kind/stable ID remain.

Health current/capacity are actual pure getters returning _current/_capacity. The moved single boolean read occurs after original create/null/copy/id/clear. ResourceRewardChoice.make and ItemDefinition have no callback/custom initializer/await between old heart reads; local newly created resources have no external observers at that time. Thus the finite current synchronous path has unchanged full-health decisions; no claim for hypothetical future side-effect getters.

Generator changes only the note amount subexpression to the same pure tier rule. RNG creation, next_int count/order, heart amounts, reverse and item draws are byte-identical. Multi-seed Manifest-byte equivalence still requires actual native output comparison.

Added pure cases characterize identity/order, resource-only second-item precedence, unknown tier, one fallback and duplicate notes. Four actual App cases use the existing empty pool-provider seam and disclosed fixed chest declarations; they do not claim those are naturally generated empty-pool seeds. All original runner source and 93 actual check-call lines remain, plus 12 new check sites.
